title: LiteSpeed ESI saved-setting retest result
esi_state_evidence: x-litespeed-cache-control includes esi=on on product, cart, and checkout responses

product.interpretation: ESI is definitely enabled now, but the product remains explicitly non-cacheable. No HIT was observed.

comparison_to_unsaved_test.note: Small latency improvement only; because responses remain no-cache with no HIT, this is not evidence that ESI fixed caching.

decision: ESI does not resolve the product no-cache root cause. Continue investigation toward the actual product no-cache owner, with emphasis on the product singular request path and woocommerce_recently_viewed behavior.
